p1_definition: All MEDIUM findings in the 2026-09-30 A01-A20 master audit inventory.

tracks.P1-01: Repository authority, reproducibility, reviewer bootstrap and route source truth
tracks.P1-02: Typed transaction semantics and all-canon semantic assurance
tracks.P1-07: Economics, treasury, rewards and fee integrity
tracks.P1-10: Claims truth, repository messaging and browser credential custody

findings.summary: Authoritative main branch does not enforce the validation gates
Clean checkout proof is not a clean-machine/hermetic reproducibility proof
Generated V2 route inventory includes four unmounted duplicate endpoint implementations
Schema accepts textual false while social execution applies it as true
findings.evidence: Strict JSON boolean semantics are enforced for FOLLOW_SET, BLOCK_SET, and MUTE_SET at both schema and apply boundaries. The 3x8 coercion matrix rejects textual/integers and preserves real booleans; invalid direct apply leaves state unchanged. Reconciliation run 37394764328 registered invalid_payload:boolean_required, refreshed all three V2 semantic bindings, regenerated dependent evidence twice, passed clean-checkout V2/public-claim checks, and pushed workflow-free candidate 41c10839a3aeb965147006ca57ea5f089096b751.

findings.summary: Nonzero stale ledger snapshot can pass startup while newer persisted blocks already exist
Observer durable_tx_queue acknowledgement is not backed by an explicit filesystem durability barrier
Timeout certificates do not actually identify the highest referenced QC
Future constitutional-slot blocks are rejected by honest construction but accepted by follower/BFT admission before the slot
Production TLS peer connections can silently disable certificate verification
findings.evidence: Production TLS transport fails closed without a CA unless the explicit WEALL_NET_TLS_INSECURE_OK compatibility override is set. The regression remained green in the combined A10/A13 reconciliation run 37394044969 before workflow-free candidate 00619c3892753f0da7b161a44666c2145b8ce4f0 was pushed.

findings.summary: Fresh async PoH can progress using commitment-only evidence with no cryptographically bound reviewable ciphertext
findings.evidence: Post-P0 production human-authority scope lock prevents fresh async/Tier-2/Live positive authority transitions and schedulers; exact branch workflow run 37383418894 passed tests/test_p0_06_production_scope_closure.py.

findings.summary: Anti-Sybil/collusion scoring exists as rehearsal/library logic but is not automatically enforced by the canonical PoH lifecycle
findings.evidence: Post-P0 production human-authority scope lock prevents canonical positive human-authority progression while uniqueness/entropy work remains unresolved; exact branch workflow run 37383418894 passed tests/test_p0_06_production_scope_closure.py.

findings.summary: Reward scheduler reallocates empty-bucket and split remainder value to the protocol treasury
Generic treasury cancellation is authorized by a global emissary role rather than treasury-scoped cancellation authority
findings.evidence: TREASURY_SPEND_CANCEL is now canon-gated by treasury-scoped Signer authority, and the treasury applier independently checks the proposal-time allowed_signers snapshot (or derives a scoped legacy set) before mutation. The adversarial regression proves a globally seated non-signer emissary cannot cancel another treasury's spend. Reconciliation run 37394044969 refreshed TX-0506 semantics, regenerated dependent evidence twice, passed clean-checkout verification, and pushed workflow-free candidate 00619c3892753f0da7b161a44666c2145b8ce4f0.

findings.summary: Positive FEE_PAY can remove balance value without a destination or explicit burn accounting
findings.evidence: Positive FEE_PAY without an explicit disposition now fails atomically with fee_destination_required; destination-backed fees remain conserving. Remediation workflow run 37383826940 passed the new focused regressions, existing economics alignment tests, and canon sanity before committing the repair.

findings.summary: Positive transfer fee policy is currently unenforceable
findings.evidence: Configured positive BALANCE_TRANSFER fees are now settled atomically in the transfer transition: sender is debited amount+fee, recipient and canonical fee sink are credited, settlement is bound to deterministic transfer_id, missing sink/insufficient total funds fail closed, and replay dedupes before re-charge. A standalone zero/wrong FEE_PAY cannot authorize bypass. Reconciliation run 37391108169 passed targeted economics regressions, semantic refresh, two regeneration rounds, clean-checkout V2/B528/B534/B567/public-claim freshness, and pushed workflow-free candidate 08fd14aff62921ee505bfd21ae35de6c5bc7772f.

findings.summary: Anonymous mempool status returns complete pending transaction envelopes despite a redacted-public contract
findings.evidence: Public /v1/status/mempool now projects a strict allowlist of pending transaction metadata and excludes payload/signature contents. Secret-marker regression plus existing status diagnostics and canon checks passed in remediation workflow 37384931649; implementation commit 652f8dd81b036cb4527826ca828d5334745375be.

findings.summary: Observer-edge operator authorization trusts loopback peers by default
findings.evidence: Production observer-edge operator authorization no longer trusts loopback peers by default: missing/bad token loopback requests are rejected and only the configured token passes, while dev-only convenience remains explicitly bounded. The regression remained green in combined reconciliation run 37394044969.

findings.summary: Alternate encodings of the same ML-DSA key are treated as different protocol authorities
Signature-profile mode policy and explicit allowlist can fail open to ML-DSA
findings.evidence: Runtime signature-profile admission enforces registry mode flags and explicit allowlists are authoritative: empty, unknown-only, and mixed-invalid policies fail closed rather than restoring pq-mldsa-v1; mainnet rejects ML-DSA while registry mainnet permission is false, while controlled/public testnet remains explicitly allowed. Transaction, block, validator/operator, and public-testnet caller matrices passed, and combined reconciliation run 37394044969 regenerated exact-tree evidence before pushing candidate 00619c3892753f0da7b161a44666c2145b8ce4f0.

findings.summary: An older persisted read can overwrite a newer committed in-memory canonical state
Health/readiness endpoints are rate-limit-exempt but load and parse the entire ledger snapshot
Public state snapshot has unbounded response/work size and recursively copies/redacts the whole state
A02 apply-failed replay defect is an indefinitely reusable block-capacity exhaustion primitive
findings.evidence: P0-01 made canonical failed user inclusion one-shot by consuming nonce and preserving committed identity semantics; exact branch workflow run 37383418894 passed the focused one-shot regression and the broader P0 overlap regression suite.

findings.summary: Transaction coverage is structural; no all-236 semantic property/mutation matrix exists
Full reviewer-readiness reproduction depends on Git history, not only the current source archive
Application lockfiles do not make the full clean-machine build hermetic
Current clean CI proves source/install/test health but not complete node restart/replay reproducibility
Current verified-claims registry cannot invalidate itself from same-tree adversarial findings
Verified-human tier wording omits the critical uniqueness/Sybil limitation at the point of claim
Public repository description overstates exact canon conformance
Advertised one-command tester node is not a self-contained clean-clone bootstrap
fresh_clone_smoke.sh can pass without exact-commit binding or frontend verification
Reviewer verification paths are fragmented and non-equivalent without a front-door decision tree
Raw API session bearer key is persisted in browser localStorage
findings.evidence: Durable localStorage now retains non-secret session metadata only; the reusable bearer is tab/session-scoped in sessionStorage, legacy persistent bearers are scrubbed/migrated, and logout clears the bearer. Custody source proof, existing account-custody checks, TypeScript typecheck and Vite build all passed in workflow 37385473272; implementation commit 8750238534cfdeabacc9e30d7007ff6dde1ef3fb.
